single.rationale: Signet faces persistent revenue decline (-4.6% 3-year CAGR) in a challenging discretionary retail environment, but showed stabilization with modest FY26 revenue growth (+1.6%) and strong free cash flow generation (13.6% yield). The transformative strategy and attractive valuation (7.3x P/FCF) warrant monitoring, but execution risks around brand repositioning, tariff headwinds, and uncertain consumer spending justify caution before deeper commitment.
